distribution.narrative: Huang & Lu (2015) and Yang (2020) listed Hainan. Under the checklist's regional scheme, Hainan remains within Mainland China. The 2015 Source Record has a historical shared-with-1984 marker but no separately linked 1984 record for this VSN.

host_note: Huang & Lu (2015) reported Pinus sp. (genus-level) and Picea asperata. Yang (2020) provides distribution evidence only. No separate 1984 source record is currently linked for these hosts.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus samoensis Beeson, 1929.
